verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own model routing to 90+ providers through one standard interface, and its Studio has a model picker for selecting models. That covers the multi-provider core of the story. However, the evidence never names Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or OpenRouter, and never shows assigning a model per agent or switching mid-conversation. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of the named providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter), documented per-agent model configuration, documented per-conversation model switching, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: Mastra's model routing connects to 90+ providers through one standard interface.
To hide external providers from Studio's model picker, set `AUTO_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS=true` in your `.env` so users can only select models from your own gateways.
